name: A2Reviews
author: eosvn

sections.description:
A2Reviews is a product reviews and ratings application for WooCommerce. It connects your store to the A2Reviews service (https://www.a2rev.com) so you can collect, import, moderate and display customer reviews, star ratings and questions & answers on your product pages.

Home Page | App | A2Reviews Help

Features

  • Install and connect with a few clicks.
  • Add reviews from CSV, manually, or imported from AliExpress and Amazon.
  • A smart review editor to help you manage reviews easily.
  • Email customers to request a review after purchase.
  • Review, total-rating and Questions & Answers widgets with flexible placement.
  • Shortcodes to display review blocks and widgets anywhere.

Shortcodes

  • [a2reviews-widget-feature] – Display the best curated reviews on your website.
  • [a2reviews-widget product-id="123"] – Display reviews of a particular product.
  • [a2reviews-widget type="total" product-id="123"] – Display only the total review widget.
  • [a2reviews-widget type="total-collection" product-id="123"] – Display only the total review widget without text.
  • [a2reviews-block id="123"] – Display a curated review block created in the app.

External services

This plugin is a client for the A2Reviews service and requires an A2Reviews account. To provide its functionality it connects to several third-party services operated by A2Reviews (EOSVN). It is important to disclose this because the plugin sends and receives data from these services.

When data is sent

  • When you click “Authentication” / “Connect” in the plugin settings, and while your store is connected.
  • On the front end of your product pages, when the review widgets load (the client script is requested so reviews can be displayed).
  • When a WooCommerce order is completed (so the service can request a review from the customer).

What is sent and to where

  • A2Reviews API — https://api.a2rev.com and https://app.a2rev.com — During connection and normal operation the plugin exchanges your site URL and domain, a connection signature, and, on connect, basic store/administrator information (site name, admin email and name) so the service can link your store. Review, rating and product metadata is synchronised for the products you manage.
  • A2Reviews real-time service — https://socket.a2rev.com — Used by the client script for real-time updates of review data.
  • A2Reviews CDN — https://s1-cdn.a2rev.com — The front-end client script that renders the review widgets is loaded from the A2Reviews content delivery network. Your store domain is passed as a query parameter so the correct reviews are displayed.

Use of the A2Reviews service is subject to its terms and privacy policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://www.a2rev.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.a2rev.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory and activate it (alternatively, install it through the WordPress admin plugins screen).
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  3. Go to Settings > A2reviews and click “Authentication” to connect your store to the A2Reviews service.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an account?

Yes. A2Reviews is a hosted service; you need an A2Reviews account to collect and display reviews. See the “External services” section for details on the data exchanged.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

The plugin is built for WooCommerce product reviews and requires WooCommerce to be active.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2

  • Compatibility: Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.3.
  • Compatibility: Declared support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart/Checkout blocks.
  • Fixed assigning the customer account to a guest order on stores using HPOS (the order is now updated through the WooCommerce order API).

1.3.1

  • Fixed the reviews/Q&A widget collapsing (and the content below it overlapping) when its tab is opened after being hidden; the widget now reflows correctly.
  • Added an option to hide the default WooCommerce star rating on the product page so only the A2Reviews rating is shown.

1.3.0

  • Security: Fixed an authorization flaw in the plugin’s connect/API endpoints that could allow an unauthenticated request to be processed on a store that had not yet connected to the A2Reviews service. All API commands now fail closed when the store is not connected, the one-time connection code is verified with a constant-time comparison (hash_equals()), and WooCommerce API keys can no longer be created from an unauthenticated request. Reported by Muni Nitish Kumar Yaddala.
  • Security: Escaped all plugin output and hardened input handling.
  • Compliance: Resolved WordPress Plugin Check issues (output escaping, direct file access protection, i18n, prefixing, safe redirects).
  • Updated the A2Reviews client to the latest version (1.2.6), and the client now updates automatically when the service publishes a newer one (never downgrading).
  • Fixed the review widgets showing an endless loading spinner when the store is not connected; a clear message is shown instead.
  • Added an “External services” disclosure to the readme.
  • Updated “Tested up to” to WordPress 7.1.

1.2.3

  • Fixed clear cache with WP Rocket

1.2.2

  • Fixed API port

1.1.11

  • Fixed bugs and change default CDN

1.1.10

  • Fixed update stars rating with wp-super-cache plugin

1.1.8

  • Custom version of script on your site
  • Fix bug and optimization
  • Multiple CDN server

1.1.7

  • Fixed some issues with total widget display.
  • Updated to allow customers to choose client-side version.
  • Add some options in settings
  • Add template layout for paid store.
  • A few optimization improvements.

1.1.6

  • Improve website authentication, easily connect to A2Reviews application

1.1.4

  • Fix bug on widget shortcode

1.1.3

  • Fix bug “Uncaught Error: Cannot use object of type WP_Error as array.”

1.1.2

  • Updated some Shortcodes to show reviews.

1.1.1

  • Change to new CDN

1.0.9

  • Fix custom position for total widget reviews

1.0.7 & 1.0.8

  • Fix authentication with APP

1.0.6

  • Add order complete action and shortcode to show block reviews

1.0.5

  • Fix bugs

1.0.4

  • Fix bugs and support woocommerce order assign to customer

1.0.1

  • Release the first version
